children: 1606 Corp entered a non-binding LOI with Prime Tex to explore a potential acquisition or assignment of its contractual rights for the 132-acre Lufkin biomass power and data center project.
Entered non-binding, non-exclusive LOI dated Sept 6, 2026 with Prime Tex to evaluate acquisition or assignment of PSA rights for the Project.
Any transaction subject to Prime Tex due diligence, further negotiation and execution of definitive agreements; LOI may be terminated anytime.
LOI expires Dec 31, 2026 unless extended; 1606 remains free to pursue other strategic alternatives for the Project.
Project is ~132 acres with existing biomass power infrastructure being evaluated for data center and HPC redevelopment.
Company warns LOI non-binding, financing and title issues exist; no assurance a definitive deal will be reached.
